subject.title: fix(doctor): recover sibling moltbot.json config dropped on upgrade (#54200) [AI-assisted]

question: Should OpenClaw support a one-time, doctor-only recovery from sibling `~/.openclaw/moltbot.json` when the canonical configuration is missing or skeletal?
rationale: This is not a routine implementation detail: it re-establishes a compatibility/migration promise for a retired configuration filename, including how long that recovery remains supported.

options.title: Approve bounded doctor recovery
options.body: Keep normal runtime resolution canonical while allowing explicit `doctor --fix` recovery only for missing or narrowly skeletal canonical configs.

options.title: Keep retirement strict
options.body: Do not restore from the retired filename; rely on documented/manual migration and avoid creating a new legacy recovery contract.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded doctor recovery
recommendation.body: Keep normal runtime resolution canonical while allowing explicit `doctor --fix` recovery only for missing or narrowly skeletal canonical configs.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only concrete technical-history contact supplied for the prior equivalent recovery design; formal product approval still requires a repository maintainer.
